from pathlib import Path
import re

path = Path('src/data/lyrics/salam-bar-moharram.md')
original = path.read_bytes()
opening, metadata, source = original.decode().split('---\\n', 2)
header, roman = metadata.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)
replacements = {
    'Meri dharkan meiṅ buka': 'Aza meri dharkan meiṅ buka',
    'Khatakaar huṅ maiṅ beshak': 'Khatarnak huṅ main beshak',
    'Faqat ek aansu pe hi': 'Faqat ek aansuṅ pe hi',
    'Hui chaudah sadiyaaṅ lekin': 'Hai chaudah sadiyaaṅ lekin',
    'Alamdar-e-Karbobala ka': 'Alamdaar-e-Karb o Bala ka',
    'Ya ho hathkari aur beri': 'Ya ho hathkari aur beri',
    'Karo yaad iksath hijri': 'Karo yaad iksath hijri',
    'Musalle pe tiroṅ ke tha': 'Musalle pe tiroṅ ke tha',
    'Qatl-e-shah-e-umam kaisa hua sitam': 'Qatl-e-shah-e-umam kaisa wa sitam',
    'To pyasa koi lashkar hai': 'To pyaasa koi lashkar hai',
    'To chinti hui chadar hai': 'To chhinti hui chaadar hai',
    'Har ek aankh meiṅ aansu hai': 'Har ek aankh meiṅ aansuṅ hai',
    'Kaisi hui jafa Zehra ka ghar luta': 'Kaisi hui jafa Zehra ka ghar luta',
    'Bine Sayyeda ka saaya': 'Bin Sayyeda ka saaya',
    'Shaair o nauhakhwaan': 'Shaair o nauha khwaan',
}
new_roman = []
for line in roman.splitlines(keepends=True):
    if not line.strip():
        new_roman.append(line)
        continue
    verse = line.strip()
    verse = replacements.get(verse, verse)
    verse = re.sub(r'\\bmaiṅ\\b', 'main', verse)
    new_roman.append(f'  {verse}\\n')
updated = '---\\n' + header + 'romanLyrics: |-\\n' + ''.join(new_roman) + '---\\n' + source
_, updated_metadata, updated_source = updated.split('---\\n', 2)
assert updated_source.encode() == source.encode()
roman_blocks = [block.splitlines() for block in ''.join(new_roman).strip().split('\\n\\n')]
source_blocks = [block.splitlines() for block in source.strip().split('\\n\\n')]
assert len(roman_blocks) == len(source_blocks) == 8
for number, (roman_block, source_block) in enumerate(zip(roman_blocks, source_blocks)):
    assert len(roman_block) == len(source_block), number
    if number:
        assert roman_block[0].strip() == str(number)
        assert source_block[0] == chr(0x06F0 + number)
assert all(ord(char) < 128 or char in 'ṅṄ' for char in ''.join(new_roman))
path.write_bytes(updated.encode())
print('Verses per block:', [len(block) - bool(i) for i, block in enumerate(source_blocks)])
print('Total:', sum(len(block) for block in source_blocks) - 7)

item.text:
Audited `salam-bar-moharram.md` verse by verse. The Roman transliteration aligns with all 109 Urdu verses across the preamble and seven stanzas. Restored the omitted opening `Aza` in stanza 1 and corrected Roman wording and spelling against the Urdu. The Urdu body and metadata were preserved.

The readings `wa` in stanza 5 and `Bin Sayyeda` in stanza 7 remain uncertain and need human editorial sign-off.
